findings.title: Profile update binds entire request body to User model
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can set privileged fields such as role or admin flag via the profile update endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Limit bound fields to a whitelist and set privileged fields server‑side.

findings.title: Profile update binds entire request body to User model (duplicate route)
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can set privileged fields such as role or admin flag via the profile update endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Limit bound fields to a whitelist and set privileged fields server‑side.

findings.title: User registration binds entire request body to User model
findings.impact: Any user can set privileged fields such as role or admin flag during registration.
findings.recommendation: Use $fillable or guarded properties to restrict writable fields.

findings.title: Team creation allows setting owner_id via request body

evidence.why: Team::create($request->all()) binds whole body, including owner_id

findings.impact: Any user can set the owner_id of a team, effectively assigning ownership to themselves or others.
findings.recommendation: Do not allow owner_id to be set from the request; set it server‑side to the authenticated user.

findings.title: User insertion uses extract($_POST) to bind all POST fields

evidence.why: extract($_POST) pulls all POST fields into variables
INSERT uses $email and $name from extracted variables

findings.impact: Any POST field can be inserted into the users table, including privileged columns if they exist.
findings.recommendation: Avoid extract(); explicitly bind only allowed fields.

findings.title: PATCH endpoint sets arbitrary attributes from request JSON

evidence.why: for key, value in request.json.items(): setattr(user, key, value) binds all fields

findings.impact: Any user can modify any attribute of the user record, including privileged fields.
findings.recommendation: Whitelist allowed fields or use a DTO.

findings.title: User creation binds entire request JSON to User model
findings.impact: Any user can set privileged fields such as role or admin flag during account creation.
findings.recommendation: Use a DTO or whitelist to restrict writable fields.
